title: Independent manuscript review of PAP-ef6e2010 (correspondence, overclaiming, citations)
question: Does PAP-ef6e2010 main.tex/refs.bib/main.pdf at 81b8a86 quote the Lean statements exactly, report toolchain/commits/axioms correctly, separate informal from formal claims, avoid overclaiming (novelty, complexity, provenance), cite real publications with correct data, and build cleanly?
rationale: docs/PAPERS.md step 3 requires an independent manuscript review; assigned via RUN-907ba4ec.
claims: The three lstlisting Lean statements (main.tex l.175-196) match CurveX.lean l.205, LinearInterp.lean l.142, PartialAgreement.lean l.145 verbatim; the declarations are unchanged since source commits cc8dc791/8191c0f6/84ddbad8.

Toolchain v4.35.0, Mathlib 56a00585..., source commits and job counts match lean-toolchain, lakefile.toml and the PRF records; reviewer rerun: lake build succeeded (3166 jobs, tree with one untracked extra file) and #print axioms gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for all three declarations.

Blocking: main.tex l.205-207 cites the single evidence file b585f279 (Round7Axioms) for the axioms of all three theorems, but it covers only Theorem B; the axiom runs for C and D are 5da55f17 and ca0a1a26.

All three bib entries (LW02, LW03, Sat05) were verified via Crossref and the author's page as correct in title, venue, volume, pages and year (Sat05 2006 is correct); first names and DOIs are missing; relevant ledger prior work (Coppersmith-Shparlinski 2000, Kiltz-Winterhof) is omitted.
The novelty-unsettled, no-bit-complexity, open-universal-target and AI-provenance statements are present and accurate; the Hasse step for Theorem D is correctly marked as not formalized.
The LaTeX rebuild is clean (exit 0, 6 pages, no warnings, 3 underfull hboxes), and its text is identical to the committed PDF.
next_action: Author: fix B1 (cite the per-theorem axiom evidence or a new exec-recorded #print axioms run of all three declarations); address N1-N3 and N5-N6 (implicit binders and xCoord convention, Lagrange upper bound, degree-vs-cost wording, bib first names/DOIs, Coppersmith-Shparlinski and Kiltz-Winterhof); rebuild via research.py exec; limited re-review of the changed passages.
notes: Decision revise (minor): 1 blocking finding (axiom evidence misattributed for C and D), 10 non-blocking. Reviewer self-reported model identity: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), Claude Code remote session; not runtime-verifiable. Initial findings were written before reading RUN-665c4a65. 7 web lookups (2 unusable). Same provider as the authors, so independence is partial. No human check.

review.rationale: The formal correspondence is exact and the proofs check out; the honesty controls are present. One blocking evidence-citation error in the trust-base paragraph (B1), plus non-blocking framing issues (trivial Lagrange upper bound, degree-vs-cost wording), mixed theorem numbering, and bibliography/prior-work gaps.
counterexamples: Checked the paper's counterexample y^2=x^3+5/F_7, P=(3,2), g=5X: order 7 and g(x(kP))=k^2 for k=1..6 confirmed
Tried to break the Section 4 root counts, affine/distinctness conditions and constant-g cases for B, C and D: no error found
review.limitations: Cited works' full texts were not read, so novelty remains unsettled. The Lean rebuild ran in the shared working tree with one untracked extra file, not a pristine checkout. Same-provider AI reviewer; no human check.
